flags.observation: Only one onboarding beat; it never says who is speaking or what this deck performance is. Cold start stays thin.
No expert dog whistle anywhere in the frame: no name, date, term or quote from therapy history rewards insiders.
"You can stop the ride." could close any song at all; generic mood sentence without information.
Intro images "a whistle and an exit" do not return; outro links back only through the guru.
Opener "The spiritual ego meets" makes an abstraction act like a person.
"meets" repeats the "you meet" opener of beat 23 only six beats later; same family under ten lines.
"After closing" repeats the "After the fall" family three beats after beat 32.
Time and place openers ("After the fall", "After closing", "In private") chain as and-then, not therefore or but.
Card name "FrizzleBob’s Guarantee" is sung as "The Guarantee"; the printed name is altered.
Subtitle Overcompensating dropped without trace; beats 19 and 20 both announce "Gatekeeper", the cards blur together.
"any action logical after the fact" recites the power almost verbatim, a rule clause, not an aside.
"helping behavior repeats even when it fails" restates the power as a rule.
"sell a false solution confidently" recites the power as an instruction.
"vulnerable content" is a bare rule label lifted from the power.
"physical behavior" is rulebook vocabulary from the power, not a picture.
Fifteen lines exceed 105 characters, peaking at 127 here; opener plus card overruns one breath.
Tail "confusion, reinterpretation, a duck, neon symbols" is a keyword list, not a sayable phrase.
"work, love, sanity, chaos, balanced" stacks artwork tags; hard to perform with intent.
Double colon in "you meet: Future Self: The One Who Left" blurs opener and card; "situation escaped" is garbled.
Opener names a second card, so two titles collide in one breath before the actual card.
"two chairs facing setup" is grammatically broken; raw artwork fragment.
"measuring regret, meter" echoes the card name as tags; redundant tail.
No style text supplied with the candidate; groove, BPM range and genre rotation cannot be verified.
